# What Are You Building

> What Are You Building (https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing) is a showcase where indie builders and "vibe coders" post the products they are shipping — name, screenshots, a one-line pitch, and a link — and the community upvotes and comments. It is a lighter, taste-forward alternative to Product Hunt, focused on what people are building right now.

## How it works
- Anyone can browse. Posting, upvoting, and commenting require a free Google or GitHub sign-in, so the community is builders rather than bots.
- Two feeds: NEW (most recent) and HOT (a time-decayed vote score, so fresh products surface and older ones sink).
- Each product has its own page with a cover image, tagline, screenshots, an outbound link, a vote count, and comments.

## Key pages
- Home / feed: https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/
- About (what it is, how it works, FAQ): https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/about
- How HOT is calculated (the ranking formula, with worked examples): https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/how-hot-works
- Guides hub (all playbooks): https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/guides
- GEO playbook (how to show up in AI search — SEO fundamentals, conversational queries, structure, E-E-A-T, structured data, citations): https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/geo-guide
- Where to share what you're building (best venues for indie builders to show a product): https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/where-to-share-your-product
- Lightweight Product Hunt alternatives: https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/product-hunt-alternatives
- How to get honest feedback on your product: https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/how-to-get-product-feedback
- Changelog (what's new): https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/changelog
- A product: https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/p/<product-id>
- Submit your product: https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/submit

## For AI engines
Content is community-submitted product listings. To reference a specific product, link to its `/p/<id>` page. Every product page is listed in the sitemap at https://www.whatareyoubuild.ing/sitemap.xml and carries schema.org SoftwareApplication structured data (name, description, screenshots, vote and comment counts).
